extracted.intended_audience: general readers interested in internet privacy, hacking incidents, and celebrity news
extracted.subtask_short: encyclopedic article on celeb photo leak
extracted.subtask_description: A Wikipedia encyclopedic entry summarizing the 2014 unauthorized release of private celebrity photos (commonly 'Celebgate' / 'The Fappening'), covering procurement, distribution, reactions, investigations, and legal outcomes. The page synthesizes reportage, security commentary, and subsequent criminal prosecutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Two-factor authentication as prevention
rubrics_metrics.description: Security analysts have stated that the breach could have been prevented through the use of two-factor authentication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The article reports experts recommending two-factor authentication as a concrete mitigation; Apple said it would broaden and encourage the use of two-factor authentication in future software/OS versions (e.g., iOS 8).

rubrics_metrics.name: Disable automatic cloud photo syncing (Photo Stream) to reduce risk
rubrics_metrics.description: A Forbes writer recommended completely shutting down the iCloud 'Photo Stream' feature (which automatically uploads photos taken with an iOS device to iCloud servers).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as an advised defensive action to reduce exposure of locally taken photos to cloud backup/restore vectors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notify users on account restores and web logins
rubrics_metrics.description: Apple planned to provide notifications whenever data is restored to a device via iCloud and after logging into iCloud via a web browser, in addition to existing password-change notifications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is given as an example of platform-side security/notification improvements intended to help users detect unauthorized access or restoration events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Phishing and brute-force attacks are primary attack vectors
rubrics_metrics.description: Apple reported victims' iCloud account information was obtained using 'a very targeted attack on user names, passwords and security questions', such as phishing and brute-force attack guessing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The article describes how attackers used phishing emails impersonating Apple/Google and automated guessing to harvest credentials; emphasizes user-targeted social-engineering methods as common vulnerabilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Platforms must enforce anti-doxing/child-protection policies
rubrics_metrics.description: Reddit administrators were criticized for allowing sharing in alleged violation of their anti-doxing rules; Reddit removed /r/TheFappening and took down underage images and warned reposting would lead to bans and possible prosecution for distributing child pornography.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page uses Reddit's actions as an example of moderation responses required when doxing or underage sexual imagery appears; indicates platforms should remove such content and enforce rules promptly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Platforms and services have responsibility to remove illicit content expeditiously
rubrics_metrics.description: A threatened $100 million lawsuit alleged Google 'failed to act expeditiously, and responsibly to remove the images' and 'knowingly accommodating, facilitating, and perpetuating the unlawful conduct'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cited as an expectation / legal claim that large platforms must respond quickly to takedown requests for unlawfully obtained intimate images; used to illustrate potential civil liability for inadequate response.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal accountability and criminal charges for unauthorized access/distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Individuals pleaded guilty to counts such as unauthorized access to a protected computer and aggravated identity theft and received prison sentences and restitution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The article details plea bargains, charges, sentences (e.g., Ryan Collins: 18 months; others: 8–38 months) and restitution, showing the criminal-law standards invoked (CFAA violations, identity theft) and typical prosecutorial outcomes for such hacking and distribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investigative actions and evidence seizure are appropriate responses
rubrics_metrics.description: The FBI investigated, searched homes, and seized computers, cellphones and storage drives after tracking IP addresses linked to suspects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Described as standard law-enforcement procedures for digital-intrusion cases; cited to show investigative standards (search warrants, seizure of devices) used to pursue perpetrators.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media ethics: avoid trivializing victims and sensationalist labels
rubrics_metrics.description: The article reports criticism of the jocular portmanteau 'The Fappening' for trivializing the leak; journalists argued that such terms make light of a severe situation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to illustrate an evaluative standard for media coverage — language and headlines should not minimize privacy violations or sexual exploitation of victims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Victims' recourse: contacting authorities and pursuing legal action
rubrics_metrics.description: Affected celebrities contacted authorities, issued statements, and in some cases pursued legal action to obtain removal of images and seek prosecution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as appropriate victim responses and part of the accountability process; examples include Jennifer Lawrence contacting authorities and threatened civil suits against platforms for failing to remove content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Risks from third-party forensic/backup tools (ElcomSoft usage)
rubrics_metrics.description: Perpetrators used ElcomSoft tools to download iCloud backups from Apple.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Included as an operational detail illustrating how commercially available tools can be misused to harvest backups; implies a criterion for evaluating the security implications of backup access tools and account credential protection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special handling required for underage images (child pornography statutes)
rubrics_metrics.description: Because McKayla Maroney claimed to be under 18 when photos were taken, Reddit staff removed her photos and warned reposting could lead to prosecution for distributing child pornography.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlights the legal and platform obligations to remove and block dissemination of sexually explicit images involving minors and to escalate to law enforcement.
